verdict.rationale: Square's own docs show in-person acceptance of contactless cards, Apple Pay and other digital wallets through Tap to Pay on iPhone, and payment processing on Square hardware. Chip (EMV) acceptance appears only as a community remark about a 'card in the reader + pin entered' setup, and Google Pay is not named; card acceptance is also limited to a list of countries. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of chip/EMV insert acceptance, explicit Google Pay support, hands-on corroboration of in-person wallet and contactless flows.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can accept chip, contactless, and mobile-wallet (Apple Pay / Google Pay) payments in person

citations.quote: Accept contactless cards, Apple Pay, and other digital wallets in person with Tap to Pay on iPhone.
Process payments on Square hardware or online using any Internet-connected device.
Card payment acceptance with the Square app is currently available in the US, Canada, Australia, Japan, the United Kingdom, Republic of Ireland, France and Spain.
